notes.title: We're on Raid Survival Festival! Sept 17 to 24! And check our live stream
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

We're participating on Raid Survival Festival, from September 17 to 24. The event is a cellebration of the genre of Survivors-like Bullet Hell games. The event happens here on Steam and is hosted by 101XP.

Try the demo, and call some friends to play with you! Fourspell Survivors is best played cooperatively with friends! :D Demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2158750?snr=1_7_15__13

To celebrate the event, we're also setting a livestream with streamer True_Creature, so you guys can check the game and have some fun with us.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Let's watch streamer True_Creature and friends play Fourspell Survivors!
notes.notes:
Join us in upcoming stream event with our friend host True_Creature and friends as we dive into the enchanting world of "Fourspell Survivors Online"

Go check his amazing streams at:
https://www.twitch.tv/True_Creature

Please note that the demo is available during Bullet Heaven Fest, and will be up until November 20. It's your chance to take a look at this adventure! <3


Also remember to [b]wishlist the game[/b] if you like it:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2158750/Fourspell_Survivors_Online/

notes.title: Joins us in Steam Bullet Heaven Fest on November 6th!
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow survivors! We'll be participating in the Bullet Heaven Festival, here on Steam!
It'll happen from November 6th to November 20th.

Many games will be offering deep discounts and Fourspell Survivors Online will have a public demo during the event.

It's a great event that highlights some of the best Bullet Heaven games on the platform, and a celebration of this new genre that so many of us love! Join us and let's survive together in Fourspell Survivors Online :D

Visit for more information on the event:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/41046058/view/3695814533489259270

Cheers,
Renan Rodrigues

notes.title: Pre-Alpha V0.2.1 - Fixing small bugs with saves and improved joystick navigation
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Small update here!

[list]
[*]Improving on save system stability (to prevent data loss)
[*]Fixing some issues with joystick navigation and general input
[/list]

I'm working on many new exciting stuff that will impact gameplay for the future updates. Also have plans for a general visual redesign of a lot a stuff. Looking forward to share with you guys when we have more to show!

Best regards,
Renan

notes.title: Pre-Alpha V0.1.3 - Updates to tutorials, online & upgrades clarity
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Reporting some updates to the current pre-alpha build available now:

[list]
[*]Adding portrait image for the Maid Mage, the support NPC
[*]Adding videos for better tutorial clarity
[*]Special animations now appear for every player in the room (the character face that appears on the side)
[*]Better stability for online connectivity
[*]Adding error messages when there's any problem creating or connecting to a game room
[*]Added icons to clarify what spells are affected by each upgrade
[/list]

More updates coming soon. Have a nice day!

Best regards,
Renan

notes.title: PRE-ALPHA available! Let's build a great coop survivors game with your feedback
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Fourspell Survivors pre-alpha is currently available to be tested on the "Download Demo" button on the game's store page. We plan to keep this pre-alpha version playable only for some weeks, so now's your chance to have an early play at the game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2158750

You can test and submit feedback to us on community hub!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2158750

A big part of the core gameplay (including online coop) can be checked already, but the game's still on an early stage so please understand there are a lot of quality of life and important features missing or incomplete that we're still working on and will be arriving on the next builds, as we keep updating it.

We understand that joystick support is very important as well. We're working on it and will release it as soon as possible.


Best regards, hope you have fun!
Renan
